build_mp3d_eqa_dataset: build a python module to load the Matterport3D Embodied Question Answering dataset from a gzipped JSON file
create_default_config: create a default MP3D EQA v1 dataset config with OmegaConf for a specified split
load_episodes_from_json: load EQA episodes from a JSON string into the Matterport3dDatasetV1 dataset object
check_dataset_paths: check if the MP3D EQA dataset data path exists for the given config split
register_eqa_dataset: register the MP3DEQA-v1 dataset with the Habitat registry for use in embodied QA tasks
